title: santalum lanceolatum var. typicum
intro: Santalum lanceolatum var. typicum, commonly known as the Queensland sandalwood, is a variety of the Queensland sandalwood tree (Santalum lanceolatum), native to the subtropical regions of Australia. This plant is known for its valuable timber and essential oil, which has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Santalum lanceolatum var. typicum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include santalol and santalen, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
